_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na egwuregwu {num_players}-onye na-egwu egwu Liar's Dice. Iwu: - Na oge gị, ị nwere ike: 1) Mee ọnụahịa ọhụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ dị elu ma ọ bụ ihu dị elu (ma ọ bụ ha abụọ) karịa ọnụahịa ugbu a; ya bụ '[Bid: 3, 4]', 2) Kpọọ ọnụahịa ikpeazụ site na ịpị '[Call]'. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọọ: - Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnụahịa ahụ n'ezie n'etiti dice niile dị obere karịa ọnụahịa ahụ, onye ikpeazụ na-enye ego ga-atụfu otu die. - Ma ọ bụghị ya, onye na-akpọ oku ga-atụfu otu die. A na-ewepụ onye ọkpụkpọ nke ruru 0 dice. Onye ikpeazụ fọdụrụ na-emeri.

board.new_round: New gburugburu - Remaining dice: {dice_summary} Gị ugbu a Dice bụ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses: Onye na-egwu egwu {current_player_id} na-akpọ! Ọnụ ọgụgụ ihu {face_value} bụ {count}, nke dị obere karịa {quantity}. Onye na-egwu egwu {loser_id} (onye ikpeazụ na-enye ego) na-efunahụ otu die.
call.caller_loses: Onye na-egwu egwu {current_player_id} na-akpọ! Ọnụ ọgụgụ ihu {face_value} bụ {count}, nke bụ >= {quantity}. Onye na-egwu egwu {loser_id} (onye na-akpọ) na-efunahụ otu die.

action.bid_announce: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} na-enye {quantity} nke ihu {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: A na-akpọ oku na-enweghị ihe ọ bụla e bu ụzọ kwuo.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action not recognized as either a valid '[Bid: X, Y]' or '[Call]'. Submitted action: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọhụrụ {new_quantity} dị ala karịa nke ugbu a {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọhụrụ {new_face_value} dị ala karịa ugbu a {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Ihe a na-enye bụ otu ihe ahụ a na-enye ugbu a.
bid_reason.face_range: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọnụahịa ga-adị n'etiti 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} ka ewepụrụ site na ịgagharị na-abaghị uru.
